findings: The workbook implementation has 17 COLS entries although the build_matrix.py module docstring says the column count was reduced to 16.

The build_matrix.py build() comment says no freeze panes, but executable code sets freeze_panes to B{HR+1}; it also sets an auto_filter over the element matrix. references/layout-constraints.md separately says the header and identifier column are frozen.
The to_figure.py module docstring says it selects the decisive disputed element or the first one, but the current convert() implementation iterates every element whose dispute is 有争议待证.

The sample's P1 is tied to a 形成 claim and method=法律关系分析法, yet it still contains P1-1/P1-2 rows labelled as constitutive elements. This conflicts with SKILL/extraction guidance that formation claims should not be broken into request-right elements.

P3 is marked track=反诉 but has no claim_ref; the claims array has no matching continued-performance counterclaim. The case.counterattacks item is 抵销, whose handling says it should be filed as a counterclaim, but the sample does not explicitly connect that item to P3.

A3 requires each four-part argument segment to identify its actual source. The example elements have no src object. check_claims.py does not enforce a src value for each non-empty segment; to_figure.py falls back to SRC_DEFAULT labels.

to_figure.py cards_of() calculates absence metadata but passes it as _blank to add(), where the parameter is not used. The sample's P1-1 second field says 无书面记载 while scope.not_obtained includes 质证意见. This distinction is not resolved by the sample.
Evidence is represented as free-text names such as 原证2·招标文件, not immutable Document ID, version, SHA, page or text-range anchors.
